texts: good. the contributing event, the Northcove as contributor, mire-essence as what is contributed and the central pool as destination are all covered.

good. the station, its link to Sunken Cove, the drawing event, the essence and the pool as source are all covered. One note needing no action: "the central pool" is encoded here as a pool that happens to be central, while the previous sentence fused it into a single "central pool" kind — the same phrase can land either way, so a later query may have to look for both forms.

good. the definite plural becomes a group of stations, "exposed" is handed to each station individually rather than predicated of the set as an object, and both the group-level drawing and a per-station rule are emitted.
good. "each redistribution" becomes a rule that can fire, giving every redistribution its own recording event, with the Council as recorder and the ledgers as where it is written.
